request: One 1x1 stack of individual rocks, including the entire bottom layer; no ground plane, foundation, slab or platform. Keep the approximate isometric footprint and sparse embedded energy veins.

geometry.structure: Individual overlapping bottom rocks support the larger rubble above; four exposed flat mineral seams remain embedded in upper stones. The outer edge is formed only by rock volumes.

generationAuthorization.scope: Explicit approval to upload this model's Depth image, prompt and workflow parameters to the stated ComfyUI destination and download three Dev 12-step candidates.

generationResult.review: All three raw candidates retain a rock-only base and broad readable stone fields. However, each replaces the approved low multi-rock pile with fewer much taller central boulders, and the mineral seams become brighter, more saturated and more continuous. Do not promote directly to 48-step refinement. The raw outputs are preserved without masking away these changes.

lowerStructureCorrection.intent: Remove generation-induced central height and excessive vein brightness using the same approved low v2 Depth; no image squashing, hard silhouette cropping or runtime changes.
lowerStructureCorrection.review: Candidates 1 and 3 restore a much lower, broader profile with rock-only bottoms. Candidate 3 is preferred for its natural layered rubble and irregular exposed mineral patches; candidate 1 has more gem-like inset pockets. Candidate 2 remains taller and has an unwanted paving-like lower layer. Mineral blue remains brighter than requested and the exact four modeled seams are not preserved, so no candidate is silently accepted or promoted to 48-step refinement.

mineralVariations.strongerAttemptOutcome: Only layouts 1 and 3 were generated; old mineral locations remained dominant. Neither is counted among the five delivered layouts.
mineralVariations.standardAttemptOutcome: Denoise 0.30 changed texture but did not redistribute the blue mineral patches; excluded from the requested five layouts.
